description: Committee recommends City Council adopt the 2026-2029 Strategic Plan.

chips.text: Debate focused on removed housing and homelessness KPIs due to data collection issues.
Administration reached out to organizations to engage hard-to-reach demographics.

description: Committee recommends repealing outdated crest and coat of arms bylaw.
Also recommends amending corporate visual identity policy.
New registration protects city's coat of arms.

chips.text: Councillor clarified city's coat of arms is not changing, only bylaw.
A resident asked if the city's code of arms was changing.
Outdated bylaw did not adequately protect the city's coat of arms.

description: Approves 2025 travel and training funds for City Council.
Approves car allowance expenditures for City Council in 2025.

chips.text: Taxpayers fund City Council car allowances for 2025.

description: Council requests report on advisory committee spending.
Report to cover 2023-2025 funds and mandate alignment.
Administration to propose options for clearer spending oversight.

chips.text: Councillor MacDonald noted advisory committees use discretionary funds in varied ways.
Five advisory committees and community groups seeking funds are affected.

description: Council approved an update to the TCU Place Naming Rights contract.

chips.text: TCU Place organization affected by naming rights contract update.
